title: PubSubMessage
description: What the collector publishes to Pub/Sub for each accepted event or ping, and the processor re-validates: the client's payload as received, and the fields the collector derives. The client's IP address is never part of it.

schema_version.description: The wire schema's major version: this file's.

received_at.description: When the collector received the payload, by the server's clock: Unix epoch milliseconds.

region.description: The data region that collected it, such as europe-west1.

country.description: The ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country derived from the client's IP address, when one could be; the address itself is dropped.

subdivision.description: The ISO 3166-2 subdivision derived from the client's IP address, when one could be, such as SE-AB. Never on a ping's message: a ping carries country-level geo only (06 §3).

browser_family.description: The browser family the collector parses from the user agent, such as Chrome or Firefox, when it could. Never on a ping's message.

browser_major.description: The browser's major version the collector parses from the user agent, when it could. Never on a ping's message.

os_family.description: The operating system family the collector parses from the user agent, such as Windows or iOS, when it could. Never on a ping's message.

event.description: The client's payload: an event, or an anonymous ping.

DeviceClass.description: The coarse device class the collector derives from the user agent.
